name: Indico Capital Partners
position: Indico is one of Lisbon's reference early-stage VCs, backing founders who use technology to solve big problems and take them from local to global. It runs an ICT fund and a Blue Fund for climate and ocean startups, and its portfolio ranges from Talkdesk and Indie Campers to Infraspeak, Nutrium and Primetag.
lede: I'm a Lisbon-based Product & RevOps manager. Your portfolio is full of B2B SaaS and martech companies scaling out of Portugal, and that's precisely the ground I've covered for nine years: Primetag, Data4Deals, Infraspeak and InnovationCast sit right on top of it.
summary: Indico backs companies at the moment they go from local to global, which is when product and revenue operations stop scaling on goodwill. I've worked both sides of that problem: as a PM on AI-heavy B2B and B2C SaaS (KYC at Pi Network, geofencing at HEROW) and as the person wiring CRM, tiering and onboarding at Vibe.co in New York. Your martech, fintech-data and B2B SaaS companies are where I'd add value fastest, and I can do it on-site in Lisbon.

reasons.title: Martech and fintech data are home turf
reasons.body: I've worked on ad tech from both sides, as a platform (Vibe.co) and on the publisher side, helping start Pi Network's ad network. That maps directly to Primetag, Data4Deals and FRVR.

reasons.title: B2B SaaS that needs a revenue engine
reasons.body: Infraspeak, Nutrium, InnovationCast and Remote all sell through sales and CS teams. I've built the pipeline stages, health scores and onboarding automation those teams run on.

reasons.title: On the ground in Lisbon
reasons.body: Many of your companies have their core teams here. I'm Lisbon-based, I speak French, English and Portuguese, and I can sit with a founder's team from week one.

vc_notes.thesis: Enterprise and consumer tech overlap strongly; the Blue Fund side much less.
vc_notes.stage: Seed to growth, with most of the portfolio in my seed-to-Series C sweet spot.
vc_notes.platform: Hands-on partners; no dedicated talent or platform role found on the website.
